pick.name: Claude Design
pick.what: Chat-to-design canvas: prototypes, wireframes, one-pagers, decks; imports your design system; hands off to Claude Code
pick.why: Direct handoff into Claude Code (/design, /design-sync), reads your codebase design system, and exports HTML/PPTX/PDF/Google Slides.
pick.free_limits: Included on Free/Pro/Max; counts toward the same Claude usage pool as Claude Code (no separate weekly allowance)
pick.maintained: live; standalone claude.ai/design closes 14 Dec 2026 (moves into Claude)

alts.name: Google Stitch
alts.what: Google Labs AI UI design with MCP server/SDK, export to AI Studio/Antigravity/Netlify
alts.why: Free and does not consume Claude usage; use for bulk screen exploration.

alts.name: v0 (Vercel)
alts.what: Prompt-to-React/shadcn UI with Vercel deploy and GitHub sync
alts.why: Best when you want shadcn/Next.js code out of a generator.

decision: Claude Design wins on handoff: the prototype becomes code in the same toolchain. When Claude usage is tight (heavy coding weeks), explore in Stitch for free and import the result.
details: Prototyping slot merged here: Claude Design prototypes are clickable HTML.

verify.note: Support article: 'The standalone version at claude.ai/design closes on December 14, 2026'; same usage pool as Claude Code, separate weekly allowance retired; exports zip/PDF/PPTX/Google Slides/HTML plus Canva etc.; /design and /design-sync confirmed.
